purpose: Prepared, phase-gated local validation for a future original V68 policy. No validation games have been run by this plan.
candidate: REQUIRED_AT_RUN_TIME; candidate SHA-256 is frozen by the first spent_gate phase and required unchanged thereafter

v67_original.role: Current strongest original local challenger; use for local screening only.

kaito_v13_local.role: Internal local-only executable benchmark; attribution required; never adapt, submit, publish, or redistribute.

boey_replay_proxy.role: Local reconstructed proxy from public behavior; stress-test only, not live adaptive policy.

ernnn_backbone_proxy.role: Local reconstructed proxy from public behavior; stress-test only, not live adaptive policy.

lizs_backbone_proxy.role: Local reconstructed proxy from public behavior; stress-test only, not live adaptive policy.

spent_pre_screen.use: Already-spent candidate gate against V67 and V56 only; repeated results are diagnostic and never fresh evidence.

fresh_broader_panel.use: V68 paired broad panel only after prior gates.

sealed_final_holdout.use: Remains sealed; not available for development, diagnostics, or this protocol.

seed_ledger.collision_rule: Never reuse 94700 as fresh evidence. Keep all spent/reserved ranges above disjoint; check candidate branch ledgers before running. The 93000-93049 final holdout stays sealed regardless of local outcomes.

spent_gate.gate: Both seat orders must be strict wins against each of V67 and V56 (2/2 each), zero errors/timeouts/incomplete games. This is only a candidate eligibility filter on a spent seed.

smoke.gate: Zero errors, timeouts, invalid/incomplete games; both seats against both opponents. Diagnostic only.

historical_gate.gate: Zero errors and exactly 10/10 strict wins against every historical agent; five seeds x both seats. Draws and errors are non-wins.

stronger_panel.gate: Zero errors; >=95% strict wins overall; >=90% against each opponent and in each seat; whole-seed-block 95% bootstrap lower bound >=90%. This is a screening panel, not live top-ten evidence.

broader_paired_panel.gate: Zero errors; strictly >95% strict wins overall; >=90% against every opponent and in each candidate seat; whole-seed-block 95% bootstrap lower bound >=90%. Report exact uncertainty, margins, seat splits, all errors, and shop unlock schedules.

sealed_final_holdout.status: SEALED; not implemented as a runnable phase. Do not run or inspect under this protocol.

metrics.uncertainty: Two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson intervals plus 20,000-replicate percentile bootstrap resampling whole seed blocks; report RNG seed 68001.
metrics.per_game: Save strict result, candidate seat, both final scores, margin, statuses, timeout/error fields, runtime, source hashes, and ordered shop unlocks with day/step.
metrics.top_ten: Local games cannot establish Kaggle top-ten readiness. A top-ten claim needs a dated official leaderboard result for an authorized submission and current live episodes/opponents.

current_official_context_2026-09-26.source: Latest official leaderboard ZIP queried 2026-09-26T17:14:31 UTC; dynamic values, refresh before any external-readiness claim.
